companion.authority: Existing authenticated FaxApiClient -> owner-scoped upload/FaxDeliveryService/PDFBox; no replacement fax backend
companion.hashNormalization: SHA256 over UTF-8 without BOM, CRLF normalized to LF, all other bytes/final newline preserved

binding.start: Explicit desktop Realm preparation control after existing login
binding.auth: Opaque original authentication generation retained in desktop; backend JWT never returned to local client
binding.permission: One explicitly approved immutable prepared-job tuple; no owner-wide list or future-job grant
binding.server: Existing configured literal http://127.0.0.1:<port> only, explicit port; local authentication and relay direct/no proxy; localhost and IPv6 unsupported
binding.origin: Exact literal Host required; Origin if supplied exact; mutations require exact Origin even for native

routes.meaning: One approved job, immutable tuple plus current state
Only existing server permitted pre-submission cancellation

limits.limitsMeaning: Configured source limits; JDK pre-handler/parser/queue time, PDF parsing and total heap are not qualified hard budgets

exclusions: backend JWT or credentials in capability/assets/logs
arbitrary local/server paths or supplied document URLs
real fax or external service activation

lifecycle.revocation: Local only; not backend cancellation/logout/upload deletion
lifecycle.preparation: Freeze selected bytes, recipient, upload ID and request key; explicit uncertain retry uses original identity
lifecycle.lostUpload: Response loss may leave leased inaccessible source upload; no false cleanup
lifecycle.lostPrepare: Same known upload ID and request key reconcile; transient recovery loss requires deliberate existing desktop/server checking
lifecycle.lateResults: Closed dialog/replaced account/grant cannot publish a new local capability or document response
lifecycle.cancel: Current server state/row locking authoritative; cannot recall attempted transmission
lifecycle.download: Explicit exact snapshot; saved copies remain user files
lifecycle.retention: Source upload and job snapshot have separate existing leases; no secure-erase receipt

closedFindings: Lifecycle/socket writes and startup under UI locks
Login/relay authority mismatch, literal127 and conditional NO_PROXY
sourceReview.meaning: Source inspection only, no runtime/compile/package evidence
sourceReview.result: Independent final hashes match; no remaining concrete P1/P2 in scope
